free_tier_limits: Automatic access is limited to a synthetic test dataset. Production datasets require provider approval; Bridge charges no service fee, but MLS or data-provider licensing fees and conditions may apply.
rate_limits: No general cap on total or concurrent API requests is published currently. Zillow Public Records has a default limit of 1,000 requests per day.
resolution_notes: docs_url: use Zillow Group Data docs [https://bridgedataoutput.com/docs/platform/API/zg-data]. free_tier: true for automatic test data [https://bridgedataoutput.com/docs/platform/Introduction/Signing-up-with-Bridge-API]. free_tier_limits: provider terms vary [https://www.bridgeinteractive.com/developers/bridge-api/]. rate_limits: no general cap; Public Records is 1,000/day [https://bridgedataoutput.com/docs/platform/API/bridge]. cors: yes via Browser Token and Referrer Domain [same URL]. example: plural Properties and $top are documented [same URL].
